description: This Java source file defines the class 'RomeEventHandler' which implements event handling functionality for generating RSS/Atom feeds using the Rome library within the OFBiz framework. It initializes dependencies, handles request parameters, generates links, retrieves the wire feed, and outputs the feed content to the HTTP response.

classes.name: RomeEventHandler
classes.description: Implements the EventHandler interface to generate and output RSS/Atom feeds using the Rome library within the OFBiz web framework.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the handler by creating a service event handler and a WireFeedOutput instance.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Handles the event by generating links, invoking the feed generator service, and outputting the RSS feed to the HTTP response.
